title: A Complete Graphic Statics for Rigid-Jointed 3D Frames. Part 3: Loops for Kinematics
summary: In Part 3 of this sequence of papers, the kinematic behaviour of 3D frame structures is described using the loop formalism that was developed in Part 2 to describe equilibrium. There, the notions of polygons, polyhedra and polytopes that form the geometric toolbox underlying graphic statics were replaced by the more general concept of CW-complexes from algebraic homology.
